findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 3 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 28 questions numbered 1-28; by section: 3.1.2 1, 3.2 1, 3.3 4, 3.4 4, 3.5 3, 3.6 2, 3.6.1 3, 3.7.1 2, 3.7.2 2, 3.7.3 2, 3.8.1 1, 3.8.2 1, 3.8.3 1, 3.8.4 1.

28 five-mark questions: the unit's derivations (the special integrals of 3.3 by partial splitting and by trigonometric substitution, the Challenge formula for the integral of sqrt(a^2 - x^2), Property-IV, the cone volume by the disk method, the moment of inertia of a rod, the AUC formula for exponential decay) and its main problem types (substitution, trigonometric substitution, repeated parts, partial fractions of all four cases, definite integrals, properties, areas, consumer and producer surplus, volumes, motion, average value) with new data.
